decision.rationale: The labels define an explicit comparison of speakers tested with ethanol from a new supplier versus the Normal condition, stratified by automatic and manual drop-test methods. Although the historical candidates have compatible metric positions and broadly similar drop-test purposes, none supplies a verified reusable recipe or establishes the same source-authored condition contrast. The target labels are sufficient for a new recipe.

comparisonRelations.basis: Explicit paired conditions within the Auto drop test rows.
Explicit paired conditions within the Manual drop test rows.

groups.basis: Source-authored test condition appearing under both automatic and manual drop tests.
Source-authored normal condition paired with the new-supplier ethanol condition under both test methods.

limitations: Auto drop test and Manual drop test are test-method strata, not comparison groups.
Date, line, and input count are identifying or exposure-basis fields and are not metrics.
No numeric values, formulas, statistics, or source ranges are represented in this semantic contract.
The source-authored textual OK conclusions are not numeric metrics.
